decision: Retain Services Information as a Company Information content section, remove its side-nav entry, and use module tabs with Computational Basis first in Payroll.
rationale: Matches the exact requested hierarchy while preserving existing service configuration screens

decision: Treat payroll policies as effective-dated versioned records; transaction snapshots lock only the exact version consumed.
rationale: Future changes remain possible without rewriting payroll history

decision: Define a conflict as the same policy code with overlapping effective dates and overlapping applicability.
rationale: Allows complementary policies while preventing ambiguous duplicate versions

decision: Scope approved staggered arrangements to the selected deduction and explicit payroll date window; publish risk notices from a configurable cutoff lead time.
rationale: Prevents an approval from unintentionally changing unrelated future payrolls
